behavior_protocol: reuse E1-A v3 two-panel training probes and distance implementation
revisit_reference: all valid archive nodes born before the action, excluding current node and its direct formation parent
state_thresholds: task-specific medians estimated only from E1 prefix action states
stagnant: at least two of low movement, low revisit, nonpositive recent relative lineage gain
treatment: requested=executed Pivot versus requested=executed Refine; Fuse and fallback excluded
binary_propensity: logged operator conditional normalized over Pivot and Refine
overlap_population: retain 0.05 <= binary Pivot propensity <= 0.95; fixed from propensity support before suffix outcomes were analyzed
interaction_gate: frontier interaction >0 with 95% stratified-run bootstrap lower bound >0; >=2/3 task directions positive; stagnant Pivot and Refine IPW ESS >=20; frontier or parent-positive outcome corroborates without a single-run event

q_kernel.kernel: Gaussian bandwidth=10th visible distinct Refine parent quality distance
q_kernel.candidate_gate: Q Brier < M1 in >=3/5 tasks and both top20 frontier gain and parent positive gain >= M1
